name: app-ride-profile-screen-with-lime-pills-and-widgets
title: Profile screen with lime avatar, pill buttons, black stat block and side widgets
whatItIs: A white phone with a lime-circle avatar, big name, two big pill buttons (lime member, black upgrade), a black rounded stat block with 12 rides, 48 km, $124 in white and lime, settings rows, and a bottom nav of circular buttons with the active lime one. Two labelled black widgets float at the sides.
whatItMeans: Bold, friendly and legible; very round shapes and lime-on-black feel modern and gamified.
techniques: Use extremely rounded buttons and cards throughout.
Display stats in a black block with one lime number.
Make bottom nav a row of round buttons with the active one in lime.
Show widgets beside the phone with small caps labels.

vocabulary.definition: A dark card with several key numbers.
A labelled component shown beside the device.
